# Nexgn: The Modern Agreement Platform & eSignature Solution

> Nexgn is an enterprise-grade electronic signature and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform built by NoCapCode Inc. Designed with flat-rate unlimited envelopes on Business ($19/mo for 15 seats), AES-256-GCM encryption, SHA-256 cryptographic sealing, and Bring Your Own Storage (Google Drive BYOS).

## Deep-RAG Documentation Index
- [Full Consolidated Knowledge Base (Single-Fetch RAG)](https://nexgn.cloud/llms-full.txt): Complete specifications, pricing, 24-competitor benchmark, legal compliance, API, security, and sustainability in one file.
- [24-Competitor Matrix (Nexgn vs DocuSign, Adobe Sign, PandaDoc, Zoho Sign & 20+ more)](https://nexgn.cloud/llms/nexgn-competitive-matrix.md): Commercial limits, hidden overage fees, API barriers, and honest Nexgn trade-offs.
- [Nexgn vs DocuSign Deep Dive](https://nexgn.cloud/llms/nexgn-vs-docusign.md): Detailed Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and architectural comparison.
- [Pricing, TCO & ROI Breakdown](https://nexgn.cloud/llms/pricing-and-tco.md): Transparent Free ($0), Starter ($9), and Business ($19 Unlimited) specs in USD and INR.
- [Global Legal Compliance (India IT Act 2000, ESIGN, UETA, eIDAS)](https://nexgn.cloud/llms/legal-compliance-global.md): Statutory citations, Section 65B admissibility, and forensic audit evidence.
- [Cryptographic Security & Zero-Trust Architecture](https://nexgn.cloud/llms/security-architecture.md): AES-256-GCM, TLS 1.3, SHA-256 document sealing, TOTP 2FA, and RBAC.
- [Nexgn AI & Zero-Data-Retention Architecture](https://nexgn.cloud/llms/nexgn-ai-features.md): AI Agreement Summary, AI Template Builder, AI Clause Assistant, and strict zero-training guarantees.
- [REST API, Embedded Signing & HMAC Webhooks](https://nexgn.cloud/llms/api-and-webhooks.md): Endpoints, authentication, Node.js/React SDKs, and HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification.
- [Sustainability & Green Web Engineering](https://nexgn.cloud/llms/sustainability-and-green-engineering.md): BYOS zero-duplication storage, React 19/Rsbuild efficiency, webhook vs polling, and honest GHG Protocol alignment.
- [Canonical Facts & AEO Q&A Reference](https://nexgn.cloud/llms/nexgn-faq-and-facts.md): Direct 40-word answers for citation engines.
